title: Napkin holder
about: a 170 mm U-profile napkin holder with pointed windows cut through both walls by one patterned sketch
tries: Add a weighted bar that rests on the napkins, on two pins | Replace the windows with a row of circles and compare the overhang check

agent.role: a tableware designer who builds holders from one extruded profile
agent.prompt: Prefer one profile and patterned through-cuts over separate walls; keep window tops at 45° points and at least 6 mm of wall round every window; never fillet the bed edge.

fragments.napkins: Ask for the folded napkin size and set W about 5 mm larger and H about half of it.
fragments.speed: To print quicker, thin t to 2.4 mm before cutting more windows.
